title: Page 4
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
更令人郁闷的是温柔总是吃不惯晋王府的膳食，在古北口时她习惯了大碗喝酒大口吃肉，回到京里吃相虽收敛了不少，食量可没有变。在她看来，王府中一日三餐那些精致的吃食，味道平淡分量少，拿来喂鸡还差不多。
遑论王府里的下人个个傲气，虽然平时服侍也是毕恭毕敬，但温柔看得出来他们心底是瞧不起她这个宁化郡王妃的，认为一个武将之女，配不上天人之姿的崔静言。
幸好她自己陪嫁的奴仆也不少，可以直接无视这种情况。
将一头鹰硬是关在精美的牢笼里，没多久便令人受不了了。
晋王府按制规划得工工整整，前半依次为承运堂、寰堂、存心堂，皆是华丽非常，窠拱攒顶，饰以金边，中画蟠螭、八吉祥花，是晋王设宴或接见的场所。
后半除了晋王夫妇所居之正院和世子居住的东院，其余六处院子分别被晋王取了名字，即为守恭院、守俭院、守卑院、守畏院、守愚院、守浅院。
此出自于周公诫子之语，德行宽裕，守之以恭者，荣；土地广大，守之以俭者，安；禄位尊盛，守之以卑者，贵；人众兵强，守之以畏者，胜；聪明睿智，守之以愚者，哲；博闻强记，守之以浅者，智。
而将府中院子取了这样的名字，也是有向今上表态之意。毕竟晋王手握西北兵权，坐镇太原，即使如今皇帝是晋王亲侄，和崔静言交情极佳，目前看起来又有些不思进取，却不代表哪一日他会雄起，进而对王府忌惮。
守恭院如今是崔仲衡夫妻所居，崔静言夫妻住在守俭院。这守俭院有正房三间，后房五间，东西厢房各三间，最外侧还有一连的多人房共七间，中间是太湖石堆筑的假山，下方一弯流水，一座凉亭高据假山顶，四周林木蓊郁，槐榆海棠梅花等散植其中，又隐约露出一条石道来。
这该是不俗的景色，但温柔身处其中却十分憋屈。她想射个箭，这院中奴仆处处，没有让她能畅快张弓的地方；想练刀，动作只要大些，不是砍到树就是削断花，过后必然只剩残花败柳；更不用说骑马，马儿能不能在假山流水中恣意行走都是个问题。
于是温柔忍了几日，终于来到崔静言面前，劈头便道：「喂，崔静言，王府里可有供人练武的演武场？」
她自己曾经在整个王府后半东绕西找了半天，前半她又不方便常去，问下人也问不出个所以然，像是人人都在提防她，最后的结论就是找不到。
崔静言在接受自己失忆三年的事实后，便镇日窝在书房，观览这三年来的邸报、政务、帐簿等等，试图把空落的记忆填补起来，所以他忙得很，不仅要接见他手下产业里里外外的管事，还要暗中与宫里来的人接头，好不容易觑个空休息，结果温柔便寻了来。
他自是没好气地直接回了句，「没有。」还顺带喝了口茶，一个眼神都没给她。
温柔并不气馁，无视他不善的态度，像他没有失忆般自在的在旁坐下，还将他的杯子取来，一口饮尽。
「如果我想弄个演武场，府里可有空余之地？」她眨眨眼睛，期待地问。
茶被抢了，就知这女人粗俗不堪，但总不能按住她抢回来，先不说打不打得过，这毕竟有失他君子端方之仪。
崔静言终于正眼看她，却见她喝茶的仪态倒是不错，没有想像中的粗鲁，反而有种率性的美感，不由多看了一眼。
「倒是有一处。」他淡淡地道，按下心中居然觉得她美的莫名感受。
「在哪里？」她的眼神晶亮起来。

崔静言又取来一个杯子，慢悠悠地替自己倒了杯茶，才想放下茶壶，此时温柔把喝空的杯子也递到他面前，他顺手斟满，斟满之后立即后悔，暗骂自己这是什么奴性，她让他倒茶他就倒？
崔静言放下茶壶，心里不由烦闷起来，完全忽略方才那自然而然的反应，只是喝着自己的茶，若无其事地说道：「在王府东南角，守愚院附近有一块空地，我记得已经空了许久，开辟出来做演武场应当够大。」
他并没说能不能用，只说够不够大。
不过温柔自动自发地解释为，那块地能够给她用，于是她欣喜地将茶杯往前一推，也不喝了，随口道别便轻快地出了书房。
第一章 成亲当天失忆了(2)
待温柔离去，一向伺候崔静言的小厮知书才默默的进来，手上抬了个箱子，是崔静言命他取来的王府内帐。
原本京城的晋王府并不富裕，只勉强能维持府中上下运作，崔静言年幼时崭露出商业上的不凡后，晋王妃好奇地拿了自己嫁妆的几个铺子让他练手，想不到才一年工夫，铺子的数量及资产直接翻了倍。
最后晋王大手一挥，将京中晋王府明的暗的所有产业移交给崔静言管理，果然他接手才五年工夫，晋王就默默跃升诸王最富，连晋王自己都不知道，他的产业遍及南北，各省各城皆有土地房产，要是崔静言撂了挑子，国家税收能立马少一成。
知书平素行事沉稳周到，眼下却是有些欲言又止，崔静言余光瞥见他的异状，不由问道：「你想说什么？」
知书迟疑地开口，「方才郡王和郡王妃说了府中东南角、守愚院附近的空地可用，可是……可是郡王可能忘了，那块地虽然空着十几年，但是在去年，二房的庆成郡王妃就已经放话，那块地她要拿来盖暖房，世子妃那里好像也没有反对的意思……」
「我是忘了。」崔静言微微弯唇，笑得有些嘲讽，并没有说他早在几天前就把王府内部的情况重新弄清楚了。「不过据我对二嫂的认知，她应该还没有把暖房盖起来吧？府里公中的支出全由我而来，想盖暖房是她私人的事，我不可能替她出这笔银两，靠她那穷兮兮的几分嫁妆自己存，只怕没个三五年地基都打不起来。」
「是还没有。」知书有些感慨。
姜氏为人尖酸泼辣，对崔静言虽是巴结却疏离，每回表现友好都显得虚假，令崔静言很是看不上。虽说崔静言手里漏些银子就能帮她把暖房盖起来，但姜氏只放话不动作，或许也是在等着他主动拿钱，而崔静言从头到尾当作没这回事，姜氏可是气了好久。
「没有那不就得了，那是王府里的土地，只要爹娘和大嫂不反对，总不能说是强占了别人的。」崔静言的笑容越来越诡异。
「但……但那庆城郡王妃可不是好惹的，这么一来，我们郡王妃很可能会和庆成郡王妃起冲突……」知书最担心的就是这个，自家郡王妃在成亲之日与贼人大干一场的震撼画面，他因为一起去迎亲还历历在目，庆成郡王妃又是不能吃亏的，两人要是闹起来，府里还不鸡飞狗跳？
「你觉得，她们两个若是打起来，谁会赢？」崔静言好整以暇地问。
知书沉默了，这不是显而易见的事实？两人真要打起来，姜氏可能连一个眨眼的时间都撑不过。
「所以有什么好担心的？既然温柔坚持要做郡王妃，就要受得住压力，岂能这一点事都不会处理。」崔静言挥了挥手，让知书把箱子挪过来，随即把这事扔一边去。
知书不再多说，乖乖地抬来箱子，这里头可都是重要东西，除了帐册、秘信，还有郡王珍藏的一些小玩意儿等等，所以上了一把锁，钥匙只有郡王自己有。
content_en:
What's even more depressing is that Wen Wen can't get used to the food in Prince Jin's Mansion. When she was in Gubeikou, she was used to drinking wine and eating meat in large bowls. Although her eating habits have changed a lot since she returned to Beijing, her appetite has not changed. In her opinion, the exquisite food served three times a day in the palace are bland in taste and small in weight, and can be used to feed chickens.
Not to mention that the servants in the palace are all arrogant. Although they usually serve with courtesy, Wen Wen can tell that they look down on her, the princess of Ninghua County, and think that a daughter of a military general is not worthy of Cui Jingyan.
Fortunately, she had a lot of slaves in her own marriage, so she could just ignore this situation.
Imprisoning an eagle in a beautiful cage soon became unbearable.
The palace of the Prince of Jin was planned according to the plan. The first half is Chengyuntang, Huantang, and Cunxin Hall. They are all very gorgeous, with arched roofs, decorated with gold rims, and paintings of dragons and eight auspicious flowers in the center. They are the places where the King of Jin holds banquets or interviews.
In the second half, except for the main courtyard where the Prince of Jin and his wife lived and the east courtyard where the prince lived, the other six courtyards were named by the King of Jin respectively, namely Shougongyuan, Shojianyuan, Shoubeiyuan, Showeiyuan, Shoyuyuan and Shouqianyuan.
This comes from the words of Zhou Gong's admonishment to his children, "If you are virtuous and generous, you will be honored by being respectful; if you have a vast land, you will be safe if you are conservative; if you are humble, you will be noble; if you have a strong people and army, if you are respectful, you will be victorious; if you are smart and wise, if you are ignorant, you will be wise; if you are knowledgeable and memorized, if you are humble, you will be wise."
And naming the courtyard in the mansion like this also means to express one's stance towards the present. After all, the King of Jin holds the military power in the northwest and is based in Taiyuan. Even though the emperor is the nephew of the King of Jin and has a good relationship with Cui Jingyan, and he seems to be a little unwilling to make progress at the moment, it does not mean that one day he will rise to prominence and become fearful of the palace.
Shougongyuan is now home to Cui Zhongheng and his wife, and Cui Jingyan and his wife live in Shojianyuan. The Shoujian Yuan has three main rooms, five back rooms, three east and west wing rooms, and a series of seven multi-person rooms on the outermost side. In the middle is a rockery made of Taihu stones. Below is a bend of flowing water. A pavilion is high on the top of the rockery. It is surrounded by lush trees, with sophora elm, crabapples and plum blossoms scattered among them, and a stone path is vaguely exposed.
This should be a nice scenery, but Wen Wenwen feels very uncomfortable in it. She wanted to shoot an arrow, but there was no place for her to draw her bow freely in the courtyard. If she wanted to practice swordsmanship, she had to make bigger movements, either cutting down trees or cutting off flowers. After that, only the flowers and willows would be left. Not to mention riding a horse, whether the horse could walk freely in the rockery and flowing water was a problem.
So Wen Wenwen endured it for a few days, and finally came to Cui Jingyan and said directly: "Hey, Cui Jingyan, is there a martial arts field in the palace for people to practice martial arts?"
She herself once searched around the entire back half of the palace for a long time. It was not convenient for her to go to the first half often, and even when she asked her servants, she couldn't find out the reason. It seemed that everyone was wary of her, and the final conclusion was that she could not be found.
After Cui Jingyan accepted the fact that he had lost his memory for three years, he stayed in his study day and night, looking at the palace newspapers, government affairs, account books, etc. in the past three years, trying to fill up the empty memory. So he was very busy, not only meeting with the managers inside and outside his property, but also secretly communicating with people from the palace. After finally taking a break, he found Wen Wenwen.
He replied angrily, "No." He took a sip of tea and didn't even look at her.
Wen Wen was not discouraged and ignored his unkind attitude. She sat down next to him as comfortably as if he had not lost his memory. She also took his cup and drank it all in one gulp.
"If I want to set up a martial arts arena, is there any room in the house?" She blinked and asked expectantly.
After the tea was robbed, he knew that this woman was vulgar, but he couldn't hold her down and snatch her back, not to mention whether she could be beaten or not. After all, this was against his gentlemanly etiquette.
Cui Jingyan finally looked at her, and saw that she was drinking tea in a good manner. She was not as rude as expected, butThere is a kind of straightforward beauty, and I can't help but take a second look.
"There is one thing." He said calmly, suppressing the inexplicable feeling that she was beautiful in his heart.
"Where?" Her eyes lit up.
Cui Jingyan took another cup and slowly poured herself a cup of tea before she wanted to put down the teapot. At this time, Wen Wenwen also handed the empty cup to him. He filled it up. After filling it, he immediately regretted it and secretly cursed himself. What kind of servility was this? He just poured the tea when she asked him to?
Cui Jingyan put down the teapot and couldn't help but feel depressed. She completely ignored the natural reaction just now. She just drank her tea and said nonchalantly: "There is an open space in the southeast corner of the palace, near the Foolish Courtyard. I remember it has been empty for a long time. It should be big enough to be used as a martial arts arena."
He didn't say whether it could be used, only whether it was big enough.
However, Wen Wen automatically explained that the land could be used by her, so she happily pushed the tea cup forward, stopped drinking, said goodbye casually, and left the study briskly.
Chapter 1: Amnesia on the wedding day (2)
After Wen Wenwen left, Zhishu, the servant who had always served Cui Jingyan, came in silently, carrying a box in his hand, which was the inner tent of the palace that Cui Jingyan ordered him to fetch.
Originally, Prince Jin's Mansion in the capital was not wealthy and could barely maintain the operation of the palace. After Cui Jingyan showed his prowess in business at a young age, Princess Jin curiously gave him a few shops from her dowry for him to practice. Unexpectedly, in just one year, the number of shops and assets doubled.
Finally, with a wave of his hand, the King of Jin handed over all the properties of the Jin Palace in Beijing to Cui Jingyan for management. Sure enough, just five years after he took over, the King of Jin quietly became the richest among all the kings. Even the King of Jin himself did not know that his properties spread all over the north and south, with land and real estate in every province and city. If Cui Jingyan gave up, the national tax revenue would be reduced by 10%.
Zhi Shu usually behaves calmly and thoughtfully, but now he hesitates to speak. Cui Jingyan caught a glimpse of his strange behavior from the corner of her eye and asked, "What do you want to say?"
The magistrate said hesitantly, "Just now, the prince and the princess said that the vacant land in the southeast corner of the mansion near Shou Yuyuan is available, but...but the prince may have forgotten that although the land has been empty for more than ten years, last year, the second-bedroom Princess Qingcheng had already announced that she would use the land to build a greenhouse, and the princess didn't seem to have any objection..."
"I forgot." Cui Jingyan curled his lips slightly and smiled sarcastically, not saying that he had clarified the situation inside the palace a few days ago. "But based on what I know about the second sister-in-law, she probably hasn't built the greenhouse yet, right? All the expenses for the government and the government come from me. Building the greenhouse is her private matter. It's impossible for me to provide this amount of money for her. I'm afraid she won't be able to lay the foundation for three to five years if she saves a few cents of her poor dowry."
"Not yet." Zhishu sighed with emotion.
Ms. Jiang was a sharp and sarcastic person. Although she was fawning towards Cui Jingyan, she was distant. Every time she showed friendship, she seemed fake, which made Cui Jingyan look down on her. Although Cui Jingyan could help her build the greenhouse if she had some money missing from her hands, Mrs. Jiang only said words but did not take any action, perhaps waiting for him to take the initiative to take the money. Cui Jingyan pretended that this was not the case from beginning to end, but Ms. Jiang was angry for a long time.
"That's okay, that's the land in the palace. As long as the parents and sister-in-law don't object, it can't be said that it's been usurped by others." Cui Jingyan's smile became more and more weird.
"But...but the Princess of Qingcheng County is not someone to be trifled with. If this happens, our Princess will probably have a conflict with the Princess of Qingcheng County..." Zhishu is most worried about this. The shocking scene of his Princess having a fight with the thieves on their wedding day was still vivid in his mind because they went together to welcome the bride, and the Princess of Qingcheng County cannot afford to suffer. If the two of them had a fight, wouldn't the whole house be in chaos?
"Who do you think will win if the two of them fight?" Cui JingyanI had enough time to ask.
Zhishu was silent. Isn’t this an obvious fact? If the two of them really wanted to fight, Jiang might not be able to survive even the blink of an eye.
"So what's there to worry about? Since Wen Wen insists on being the princess of the county, she has to withstand the pressure. How can she not handle this matter?" Cui Jingyan waved her hand and asked Zhishu to move the box over, then threw the matter aside.
Zhishu said no more and obediently carried the box. There were all important things in it, including account books, secret letters, and some gadgets collected by the prince, etc. Therefore, it was locked and only the prince had the key.
